title: Learning Optimal Dynamic Matching via Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2607.28925v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dynamic matching markets require decisions about whom to match and when: matching now yields value but removes participants who may create better future opportunities. We develop a value-based reinforcement-learning framework for this problem on finite, evolving weighted graphs. We study an infinite-horizon continuous-time model with stochastic arrivals, node-type transitions, edge realizations, and exogenous exits. We prove an event-time reduction: without loss of optimality, the planner acts immediately after each exogenous event and then waits for the next one. We further show that the optimal edge-wise $Q$-function is characterized by a single continuation-value function on post-decision residual graphs, reducing the learned object from state-action values to graph values. translated_title: 通过图神经网络学习最优动态匹配
translated_abstract: 动态匹配市场需要在匹配对象和匹配时机上做出决策：立即匹配能带来价值，但会移除可能创造未来更好机会的参与者。我们针对有限、演化的加权图上的这一问题，开发了一种基于价值的强化学习框架。我们研究了一个无限时域连续时间模型，其中包含随机到达、节点类型转换、边实现和外部退出。我们证明了事件时间约简：在不损失最优性的情况下，规划者在每个外部事件后立即行动，然后等待下一个事件。我们进一步表明，最优的边级Q函数由后决策残差图上的单一连续价值函数刻画，从而将学习对象从状态-动作价值简化为图价值。精确的动作选择仍需要组合匹配优化；我们使用图神经网络近似该价值，并通过时间差分方法进行训练。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络和强化学习的动态匹配框架，通过事件时间约简和残差图价值函数，将复杂的动态匹配问题简化为可学习的图价值预测，从而高效求解最优匹配策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph neural network-based reinforcement learning framework for dynamic matching, which simplifies the complex problem via event-time reduction and residual graph value functions, enabling efficient learning of optimal matching policies.
